notes: «سمعت أبي يسأل أبا برزة»: the father asks and Abu Barza answers, so both are links (rule 5); the father is unnamed, a relation link.
«لقيته بعد فسألته» (Shu'ba meeting Sayyar again) is scene, not a new route; the chain is the same single group.
«يعني العشاء» inside the matn is an editor's gloss, not a name.
